query:
UPDATE v2_job_queue
        SET extras = jsonb_set(COALESCE(extras, '{}'::jsonb), '{failed_fast_at}', to_jsonb(now()))
        WHERE id = $1 AND running AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM v2_job_queue o
            WHERE o.id = ANY($2)
                AND (o.extras->>'failed_fast_at')::timestamptz > now() - make_interval(secs => $3)
        )
        RETURNING id
